items.title: Gartner (IT) Stock Looks Undervalued Following Its 43% Three Year Slump
items.summary: Gartner stock has had a difficult three year run, with the share price down about 43%, yet the latest valuation work now points to the shares trading at a discount to an estimate of intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and on market multiples. Over the past 3 years the stock has declined around 43%, which means recent gains have come off a much lower base.
